visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: As memory and delusion begin to blur within the halfway house, what truth is waiting inside the childhood events he cannot stop revisiting?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After moving into a halfway house, a mentally fragile man begins to slip back into an internal world shaped by his illness, meticulously reliving an unresolved chapter of his childhood.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Slow, somber, and deeply suspenseful. A demanding solo watch focused on an unraveling interior world.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Directed by David Cronenberg, this deliberate psychological thriller swaps sudden shocks for quiet, methodical tension and heavy emotional depth.
